data.summary: Glasfaser Beispielland GmbH confirms Bastian Musterquell's new fiber internet order: the connection at Quellenweg 7 goes live on 3 December 2026, starting a 12-month contract (Beispielland Faser 500) at €39.90/month.
data.explanation: This is an order confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung) for a fiber internet contract, not a bill requiring immediate action. The contract starts on 3 December 2026 with a 12-month minimum term, a monthly fee of €39.90, and a 1-month notice period at the end of that term; afterwards it continues monthly with the same 1-month notice. No action is needed now beyond keeping this confirmation for reference; the app will track the contract's end and notice dates for you.
